free_tier.stated: 5 GB stored free, but only on the Blaze pay-as-you-go plan; Spark project buckets return 402/403.

egress.terms: 1 GB/day free for legacy *.appspot.com buckets, then $0.12/GB; 100 GB/month for *.firebasestorage.app buckets. Metered beyond that.

tooling: Firebase Storage SDK / GCS JSON+XML API (rclone 'gs'/'gcs'); buckets are ordinary GCS buckets so rclone works.
chaining: 5 GB x N Firebase projects — each project needs a billing account on Blaze, which defeats the purpose since Blaze is a metered surface.
limits_note: 5 GB stored; 20K upload ops/day (appspot) / 5K/month (firebasestorage.app); 1 GB/day or 100 GB/month egress; bucket creation post-Sept-2024 uses PROJECT_ID.firebasestorage.app naming.
reliability_note: Requires attaching a credit card (Blaze). No free path at all since the Sept 2024 change — this is the clearest 'free that is not free' in the Google stack.
